scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
Do you have ^3131FFany same type of ores in your inventories^000000 which take many spaces?
I can distinguish your ores and organize them right away~!
scripts.translation:
[矿石检验员 索尔蒂]
您的背包里是不是有^3131FF同类矿石分开堆放，占了许多格子^000000？
我能立刻帮您鉴别并整理好~！

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
At the moment I can only distinguish ^FF0000Steel^000000, ^FF0000Iron^000000, ^FF0000Iron Ore^000000, and ^FF0000Rough Oridecon^000000 and organize them.
Please note that ^3131FFother items are unable^000000!
scripts.translation:
[矿石检验员 索尔蒂]
目前我只能鉴别并整理^FF0000钢^000000、^FF0000铁^000000、^FF0000铁矿石^000000和^FF0000神之金属原石^000000。
请注意，^3131FF其他物品无法整理^000000！

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
So, would you like me to organize your ores?
scripts.translation:
[矿石检验员 索尔蒂]
那么，您想让我帮您整理矿石吗？

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
Huh, I really hate messy people!
scripts.translation:
[矿石检验员 索尔蒂]
哼，我最讨厌不爱整理的人了！

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
You don't have any {0}...
scripts.translation:
[矿石检验员 索尔蒂]
您没有{0}...

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
It's done. Looks great! Don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[矿石检验员 索尔蒂]
整理好了！
看着舒服多了，您说是吧？

scripts.text:
[Ore Tester Sorty]
It seems that your bag is clean? Huhu! You might be the master of cleaning!
scripts.translation:
[矿石检验员 索尔蒂]
看来您的背包已经很整洁了嘛！
呵呵，您一定很擅长整理！
